method: All-glyph, per-size selection of natural or quantized stem fitting against the source-balanced outlines. Protect resolvable counters and separate ink cores; score multiscale ink distortion, contrast, phase variation, and subpixel details. Use strong fitting only when neither gentler mode preserves resolvable details. No character-name selection rules. Terminal artwork and appended triangles retain direct rasterization.
geometryReference: Direct quadratic/cubic paths rasterized at 256 px/em, normalized to the ink bounding box. Multiscale 8×8/4×4 ink mass and axis projections plus a density term; mean and worst horizontal phases. These are shape-fidelity proxies, not readability scores.

outlineBalance.method: Pair corresponding perpendicular stroke measurements in original and resized cubic contours. Preserve the original stroke contrast under a common affine stem scale, compensate only the extra distortion from height fitting, keep smooth joins and all advances, and reject proposals that worsen source-relative width balance or introduce contour warnings. No character-name rules.

boundsSafety.method: Test every hinted glyph at all fitted sizes/phases against its outline bounds. Allow 2 px for raster/blue-zone rounding plus PPEM/16 for proportional fitting (4 px at 32 PPEM, matching the prior release check). If a program exceeds that budget, require direct rasterization to preserve bounds, visibility, and resolvable counters/ink cores at every tested size before omitting that program. No character-name selection rules.
